name: vscode-gherkin-powertools
displayName: Gherkin PowerTools - BDD & Python Behave Toolkit
description: Write, navigate, and debug BDD scenarios faster. The ultimate Gherkin and Python Behave toolkit for VS Code.
author: Carlos Camara

gherkinPowerTools.profile.markdownDescription:
Baseline formatting profile. Individual settings always override the profile. Use `custom` (the default) to configure everything manually, or pick a preset to share a baseline across your team.

**Tip:** Set this in `.gherkin-powertoolsrc.json` to standardize formatting for all contributors.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Extension defaults — configure individual settings as needed
Strict consistency: 4-space indent, alphabetical tags, 1 blank line between scenarios
Standard team baseline: sensible defaults for large projects without being restrictive
Low-interference: 2-space indent, table alignment off, tags on one line, no blank line enforcement
Targets older Gherkin/SpecFlow codebases: 2-space indent, table alignment off

gherkinPowerTools.formatter.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the Gherkin document formatter. When `false`, the extension will no longer format `.feature` files on demand or on save. Useful for projects that manage formatting through an external CI step.

gherkinPowerTools.indentation.steps.markdownDescription: Number of spaces used to indent step keywords (`Given`, `When`, `Then`, `And`, `But`) relative to their parent block. The Gherkin community standard is `4`. Some legacy codebases use `2`.

gherkinPowerTools.tables.alignToKeyword.markdownDescription:
When `true`, the left border of Data Tables and Examples tables is dynamically padded to align with the text start of the preceding step keyword — not a fixed column.

Set to `false` for a simpler fixed-column alignment.

gherkinPowerTools.docStrings.alignToKeyw.markdownDescription:
When `true`, DocStrings are dynamically padded to align with the text start of the preceding step keyword.

Set to `false` for a simpler fixed-column alignment.

gherkinPowerTools.emptyLines.betweenScen.markdownDescription: Number of blank lines enforced between `Scenario`, `Scenario Outline`, and `Rule` blocks. Set to `0` to remove separator lines, `1` for a single blank line (recommended), or `2` for extra breathing room in dense files.

gherkinPowerTools.tags.format.markdownDescription:
How to handle long lists of tags when formatting.

- `wrap` — Splits tag lines that exceed 80 characters across multiple lines (recommended for readability)
- `singleLine` — Keeps all tags on one line regardless of length (useful for CI pipelines that parse tag lines)
markdownEnumDescriptions: Splits tag lines longer than 80 characters across multiple lines
Keeps all tags on a single line regardless of length

gherkinPowerTools.tags.sort.markdownDescription:
Tag ordering applied on every format.

- `preserve` — Tags remain in their original source order (safe default)
- `alphabetical` — Tags are sorted A–Z on every format (recommended for canonical ordering)
markdownEnumDescriptions: Tags remain in their original source order — no reordering on format
Tags are sorted A–Z on every format run

gherkinPowerTools.linter.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the real-time Gherkin linter. When `false`, no diagnostics (red/yellow underlines) will appear in `.feature` files. Useful when you rely exclusively on an external CI linter and want to reduce editor noise.

gherkinPowerTools.diagnostics.metricsEna.markdownDescription: Enable or disable parser diagnostics and performance metrics. When `true`, the extension collects data on AST parsing, cache hits, and document complexity which can be viewed using the 'Show Developer Metrics' command. Keep disabled in normal use to avoid overhead.

gherkinPowerTools.impactAnalysis.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the real-time Impact Analysis engine. When `true`, CodeLenses appear above Python step definitions showing their usage blast radius (Low, Medium, High). Useful for prioritizing testing during refactoring.

gherkinPowerTools.linter.enabledRules.markdownDescription:
Whitelist of linting rule IDs to enforce. An **empty array (default)** enables **all rules**. Populate this array to restrict the linter to only the specified rules — useful for enterprise teams that want to suppress certain checks while keeping structural validation.

**Available rules:** `MISSING_COLON`, `INVALID_KEYWORD`, `SEMANTIC_ERROR`, `TABLE_INCONSISTENCY`, `UNDEFINED_STEP`, `AMBIGUOUS_STEP`

gherkinPowerTools.behave.stepGlobs.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns used to discover Python step definition files. These patterns drive **IntelliSense**, **Go to Definition**, **Hover**, and **undefined step detection**.

Add extra patterns for monorepos or non-standard layouts. Changes take effect **immediately** — no restart required.

gherkinPowerTools.behave.ignoreGlobs.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns **excluded** from step discovery. Always exclude virtual environments and dependency folders to prevent false IntelliSense matches and performance degradation.

Changes take effect **immediately** — no restart required.

gherkinPowerTools.behave.command.deprecationMessage: This setting is deprecated in favor of the structured 'gherkinPowerTools.behave.execution' setting for improved security.
gherkinPowerTools.behave.command.markdownDescription:
The base command used to invoke Behave from the Test Explorer. Override this when using a virtual environment manager.

**Examples:** `"poetry run behave"` · `"pipenv run behave"` · `".venv/bin/behave"` · `"python -m behave"`

executable.description: The executable or runner to invoke (e.g., 'behave', 'poetry', 'python').

arguments.description: Base arguments passed to the executable (e.g., ['run', 'behave'] or ['-m', 'behave']).

gherkinPowerTools.behave.execution.markdownDescription:
Portable, shareable framework execution strategy for Behave. This setting specifies the base runner and arguments.

**Examples:**
- `{"executable": "python", "arguments": ["-m", "behave"]}`
- `{"executable": "poetry", "arguments": ["run", "behave"]}`

gherkinPowerTools.behave.localExecutable.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to a local Behave executable or Python interpreter. If provided, this strictly overrides the `executable` specified in `gherkinPowerTools.behave.execution`.

This is a **machine-specific** setting and should preferably be set in User Settings to prevent absolute paths from being committed or synchronized across machines.

**Examples:** `"C:\\Python39\\python.exe"` · `"/home/user/.venv/bin/behave"`

gherkinPowerTools.behave.additionalArgum.markdownDescription:
Extra flags appended to **every** Behave invocation from the Test Explorer.

**Examples:** `["--no-capture"]` · `["-D", "env=staging"]` · `["--format", "progress"]`

gherkinPowerTools.analytics.historicalTr.markdownDescription: Enable or disable historical trend analysis for Gherkin Health. When enabled, dashboard metrics are persisted locally to visualize project evolution over time.
Maximum number of historical snapshots to retain for trend analysis per branch.
Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for the historical trend storage in this workspace. If exceeded, oldest snapshots are pruned regardless of branch.

gherkinPowerTools.antiPatterns.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the BDD Anti-pattern Detection engine to show diagnostics and health issues.

gherkinPowerTools.antiPatterns.rules.markdownDescription: Configure severity overrides for specific anti-pattern rules. Values can be `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint`, or `off`.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Gherkin PowerTools
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to format, lint, and navigate your BDD features.

steps.title: Open or create a feature file
steps.description: Open a `.feature` file to activate Gherkin PowerTools.

steps.title: Format your Gherkin
steps.description: Format your features to align tables and standardize indentation. [Format Document](command:gherkinPowerTools.format)

steps.title: Enable Format on Save
steps.description: Save time by enabling VS Code's Format on Save setting for Gherkin files. [Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22%5Bfeature%5D%20editor.formatOnSave%22)

steps.title: Configure Behave Step Discovery
steps.description: If your Python steps are not in the default `features/steps` folder, update the Step Globs setting. [Configure Step Globs](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22gherkinPowerTools.behave.stepGlobs%22)

steps.title: Navigate to Python Steps
steps.description: Right-click a step and select **Go to Definition** (F12) to jump straight to the Python implementation. [Go to Definition](command:gherkinPowerTools.demoGoToDefinition)

steps.title: View Gherkin Health
steps.description: Generate an interactive HTML dashboard with your BDD project metrics and static analysis. [Show Gherkin Health](command:gherkinPowerTools.showStatistics)

steps.title: Execute Behave Tests
steps.description: Run and Edit your features directly from the Test Explorer. [Run Feature](command:gherkinPowerTools.runFeature)

steps.title: Intelligent Quick Fixes
steps.description: Press `Cmd + .` or `Ctrl + .` to generate missing steps, insert colons, or fix block structure. [Quick Fix](command:gherkinPowerTools.demoQuickFix)

steps.title: Gherkin Command Center
steps.description: Discover all extension capabilities from a single interactive menu. [Open Command Center](command:gherkinPowerTools.commandCenter)

steps.title: Find Documentation & Support
steps.description: Read the full documentation or ask questions on our GitHub Discussions. [Open Repository](https://github.com/carlos-camara/vscode-gherkin-powertools)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run esbuild
